description: This file defines a custom validation annotation 'FieldMatch' used to ensure that two specified fields in a Java class have the same value, commonly used for password or email confirmation fields in user input validation.

classes.name: FieldMatch
classes.description: A custom validation annotation for matching two fields' values in Java classes, with parameter options for specifying the fields, message, groups, and payload.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the default validation error message if the fields do not match.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns any validation groups the constraint belongs to.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Returns the payload associated with the constraint.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Specifies the first field name to compare.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Specifies the second field name to compare.
